title: sc-slack-persuasion manifest
description: Optional manifest for sc-slack-persuasion. Every key has a default, so nothing is required and the skill runs with no file at all.

cadence_seconds.description: Poll interval ladder in seconds, fastest first. 60 is the floor the wakeup scheduler allows.

idle_stop_minutes.description: Stop after this many minutes with no new message.

nda_surface.description: Surface passed to sc-nda-check for each draft. public by default, which over-blocks names that are fine inside a client's workspace; client_workspace when the discussions live in a client's own tenant (the tenant is the registry entity whose entry declares that surface).

voice_profile.description: Name of a voice file under ~/.claude/config/voice/, applied on top of core.md.

evidence_sources.description: What the skill may use to check a peer example before it goes in a draft. inbox reads the operator's own mail and is opt-in.
